description: This file defines the CloseSavingsAccountCommandHandler class, which handles commands to close a savings account within the Fineract application. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService to perform the account closing operation.

classes.name: CloseSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles close account commands for savings accounts, delegating the close operation to SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CloseSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to close a savings account by invoking the write platform service.
